GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 464.8 (2 Mar 46) ESS/IE
(SCAPIN - 784)
APO 500
2 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Shipment of Mulberry Seedlings to China (X029-Mu-1Ch)
1. It is directed that the necessary action be taken at once to effect the shipment to China of 200,000 miscellaneous varieties of Mulberry seedlings.
2. This shipment of seedlings will be combined with the shipment now being prepared under directive AG 464.8 (6 Feb 46) ESS/IE (SCAPIN 718) subject: “Shipment of Mulberry Seedlings to China.” The same actions will be taken as required by paragraphs 2 and 3 of the above mentioned directive.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ Harold Fair
/t/ B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General
